en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate church interior wall and vaulted ceiling. The wall features a framed triptych painting depicting Christ, the Virgin Mary, and surrounding figures. Above the painting is a sculpted cherub with outspread wings, and the vaulted ceiling is richly decorated with stucco reliefs of angels, drapery, foliage patterns, and classical mouldings. Light enters from a multi‑pane window on the right, partly overexposing that side. A handwritten marking, likely an archival number, appears at the lower left edge.
